description.en: Tasks in Sales X-Ray keeps every follow-up you promised: overdue, today and upcoming. Tick one off, push it to later, or set a reminder on any lead with Remind.
description.hi: Sales X-Ray ka Tasks aapka har promised follow-up sambhalta hai: overdue, aaj ke aur aane wale. Kaam ho gaya toh tick kijiye, baad mein karna hai toh later, aur kisi bhi lead pe Remind se reminder lagaiye.
description.mr: Sales X-Ray madhla Tasks tumcha pratyek promised follow-up sambhalto: overdue, aajche aani yenare. Kaam jhala tar tick kara, nantar karaycha asel tar later, aani kuthlyahi lead var Remind ne reminder lava.

title.en: Call a lead and log how it went
title.hi: Lead ko call karo, result log karo
title.mr: Lead la call kara, result log kara

say.en: In this video: Tasks, and Remind on any lead.
say.hi: इस video में: Tasks, और किसी भी lead पे Remind.
say.mr: या video मध्ये: Tasks, आणि कुठल्याही lead वर Remind.

latn.hi: Is video mein: Tasks, aur kisi bhi lead pe Remind.
latn.mr: Ya video madhye: Tasks, aani kuthlyahi lead var Remind.

say.en: Next: calling a lead and logging how it went.
say.hi: अगले video में: lead को call करो, और result log करो.
say.mr: पुढच्या video मध्ये: lead ला call करा, आणि result log करा.

latn.hi: Agle video mein: lead ko call karo, aur result log karo.
latn.mr: Pudhchya video madhye: lead la call kara, aani result log kara.

say.en: Promised to call back? Sales X-Ray remembers for you.
say.hi: Call back का promise किया? Sales X-Ray आपके लिए याद रखता है.
say.mr: Call back चं promise केलंय? Sales X-Ray तुमच्यासाठी लक्षात ठेवतो.

latn.hi: Call back ka promise kiya? Sales X-Ray aapke liye yaad rakhta hai.
latn.mr: Call back cha promise kelay? Sales X-Ray tumchyasathi lakshat thevto.

say.en: In Leads, open Tasks. Every follow-up you promised is here.
say.hi: Leads में Tasks खोलिए. आपने जो भी follow-up promise किया, सब यहाँ है.
say.mr: Leads मध्ये Tasks उघडा. तुम्ही promise केलेले सगळे follow-ups इथे आहेत.

latn.hi: Leads mein Tasks kholiye. Aapne jo bhi follow-up promise kiya, sab yahan hai.
latn.mr: Leads madhye Tasks ughda. Tumhi promise kelele sagle follow-ups ithe aahet.

say.en: Switch between Overdue, Today and Upcoming.
say.hi: Overdue, Today और Upcoming के बीच switch कीजिए.
say.mr: Overdue, Today आणि Upcoming मध्ये switch करा.

latn.hi: Overdue, Today aur Upcoming ke beech switch kijiye.
latn.mr: Overdue, Today aani Upcoming madhye switch kara.

say.en: Each task says what to do, for which lead, and when. Tap it to open the lead.
say.hi: हर task बताता है क्या करना है, किस lead के लिए, और कब. Tap कीजिए, lead खुल जाएगा.
say.mr: प्रत्येक task सांगतो काय करायचं, कुठल्या lead साठी, आणि कधी. Tap करा, lead उघडेल.

latn.hi: Har task batata hai kya karna hai, kis lead ke liye, aur kab. Tap kijiye, lead khul jaayega.
latn.mr: Pratyek task sangto kay karaycha, kuthlya lead saathi, aani kadhi. Tap kara, lead ughdel.

say.en: Each task: what, for whom, and when.
say.hi: हर task: क्या, किसके लिए, और कब.
say.mr: प्रत्येक task: काय, कुणासाठी, आणि कधी.

latn.hi: Har task: kya, kiske liye, aur kab.
latn.mr: Pratyek task: kay, kunasathi, aani kadhi.

say.en: Done ticks it off. The clock moves it to later, like this evening or tomorrow.
say.hi: Done से task पूरा. Clock से बाद में, जैसे आज शाम या कल.
say.mr: Done ने task पूर्ण. Clock ने नंतर, जसं आज संध्याकाळी किंवा उद्या.

latn.hi: Done se task poora. Clock se baad mein, jaise aaj shaam ya kal.
latn.mr: Done ne task poorna. Clock ne nantar, jasa aaj sandhyakali kinva udya.

say.en: Promised something on a call? On the lead, tap Remind.
say.hi: Call पे कुछ promise किया? Lead पे Remind दबाइए.
say.mr: Call वर काही promise केलंत? Lead वर Remind दाबा.

latn.hi: Call pe kuch promise kiya? Lead pe Remind dabaiye.
latn.mr: Call var kahi promise kelat? Lead var Remind daba.

target.placeholder: What you promised, in a few words

say.en: Pick what you promised and when, and add a few words.
say.hi: क्या promise किया और कब, चुनिए, और दो शब्द लिख दीजिए.
say.mr: काय promise केलं आणि कधी, ते निवडा, आणि दोन शब्द लिहा.

latn.hi: Kya promise kiya aur kab, chuniye, aur do shabd likh dijiye.
latn.mr: Kay promise kela aani kadhi, te nivada, aani don shabda liha.

say.en: Save, and it waits for you in Tasks.
say.hi: Save कीजिए, और वो Tasks में आपका इंतज़ार करेगा.
say.mr: Save करा, आणि ते Tasks मध्ये तुमची वाट पाहील.

latn.hi: Save kijiye, aur woh Tasks mein aapka intezaar karega.
latn.mr: Save kara, aani te Tasks madhye tumchi vaat pahil.
